verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents its own non-production testing paths. Unit tests run in memory and mock all external calls, integration tests deploy ephemeral infrastructure and test against it, and `pulumi preview` shows changes without applying them. Unlimited stacks and environments let test work stay separate from production. Missing for 10: a documented, dedicated sandbox or production-isolation guarantee (isolation depends on the user setting up separate stacks or accounts), agent-specific sandboxing guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
